tools.name: icontact_get_account
tools.description: The iContact account behind the credentials (company name, address, plan fields) and its client folders, with the folder this server uses. GET /a/ and GET /a/{accountId}/c/.

tools.name: icontact_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (email, name, address, phone, status, create date). Filter by status, exact email, first/last name or a list the contact belongs to. GET /contacts.

tools.name: icontact_get_contact
tools.description: One contact by id. GET /contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: icontact_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: add one contact to the account (it is not added to any list; use icontact_set_subscription for that). Not idempotent: an email that already exists is reported by iContact as a warning. POST /contacts.

tools.name: icontact_update_contact
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of one contact; only the fields you pass are sent. Setting status to donotcontact or deleted stops mail to that contact. POST /contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: icontact_list_lists
tools.description: List the account's mailing lists (name, description, welcome-message settings). GET /lists.

tools.name: icontact_get_list
tools.description: One mailing list by id. GET /lists/{listId}.

tools.name: icontact_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List list memberships (subscriptionId, contactId, listId, status). Filter by list, contact or status. GET /subscriptions.

tools.name: icontact_set_subscription
tools.description: WRITE: put a contact on a list (status normal, or pending to start double opt-in) or unsubscribe it (status unsubscribed). Only for contacts who agreed to receive mail. POST /subscriptions.

tools.name: icontact_list_campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns (the sender identity and settings that messages belong to). GET /campaigns.

tools.name: icontact_get_campaign
tools.description: One campaign by id. GET /campaigns/{campaignId}.

tools.name: icontact_list_messages
tools.description: List messages (subject, type, campaign, create date, HTML and text bodies). Filter by type or campaign. GET /messages.

tools.name: icontact_get_message
tools.description: One message by id, with subject and HTML/text bodies. GET /messages/{messageId}.

tools.name: icontact_get_message_statistics
tools.description: Delivery statistics of a message (released, bounces, opens, clicks, unsubscribes, complaints, forwards). GET /messages/{messageId}/statistics.

tools.name: icontact_list_message_activity
tools.description: Who opened, clicked, bounced from or unsubscribed after a message: one page of events for one message. GET /messages/{messageId}/opens | clicks | bounces | unsubscribes.

tools.name: icontact_list_sends
tools.description: List sends (a message sent to lists/segments: send id, message id, included/excluded lists, scheduled time, status). GET /sends.

tools.name: icontact_get_send
tools.description: One send by id. GET /sends/{sendId}.

tools.name: icontact_list_segments
tools.description: List saved segments (rule-based groups of contacts). GET /segments.

tools.name: icontact_get_segment
tools.description: One segment by id. GET /segments/{segmentId}.

tools.name: icontact_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the account's custom contact fields (name, type). GET /customfields.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "icontact_get_account" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: icontact_list_contacts, icontact_create_contact, icontact_list_lists, icontact_set_subscription, icontact_list_campaigns, icontact_list_messages, icontact_get_message, icontact_get_message_statistics, icontact_list_message_activity, icontact_list_sends · Private data: icontact_get_account, icontact_list_contacts, icontact_get_contact, icontact_create_contact, icontact_update_contact, icontact_list_subscriptions, icontact_set_subscription, icontact_list_segments, icontact_list_custom_fields · Public sink: icontact_list_contacts, icontact_create_contact, icontact_update_contact, icontact_set_subscription, icontact_list_sends, icontact_get_send.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: icontact_list_contacts, icontact_create_contact, icontact_list_lists, icontact_set_subscription, icontact_list_campaigns, icontact_list_messages, icontact_get_message, icontact_get_message_statistics, icontact_list_message_activity, icontact_list_sends · Private data: icontact_get_account, icontact_list_contacts, icontact_get_contact, icontact_create_contact, icontact_update_contact, icontact_list_subscriptions, icontact_set_subscription, icontact_list_segments, icontact_list_custom_fields · Public sink: icontact_list_contacts, icontact_create_contact, icontact_update_contact, icontact_set_subscription, icontact_list_sends, icontact_get_send

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
